correctness.rationale: Two explicit 2x2 compact H-operators are diagonalizable with real spectrum and satisfy the required resolvent estimate by similarity, while their sum has spectrum {2i,-2i}. The 2024 source itself requires a quasi-Banach linear ambient space for an approximation scheme, so the non-additive H-class cannot be that ambient space.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Searches of the paper title, DOI, arXiv identifier, relevant definition/theorem labels, and synonymous H-operator/approximation-scheme terms found no prior correction or equivalent published objection. Only the abstract of the 2026 follow-up was inspected.

value.rationale: The dimension-two obstruction isolates a structural defect in a published approximation-space formulation, separates valid Markus spectral estimates from the invalid ambient linear-space assumption, and gives a direct repair through a genuine linear operator space.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
